title: 420 Developer Hub security and developer qualification

checks.description: Evidence is bound to the selected chain ID and environment.
Developer Hub surfaces do not claim chain, Registry, Wallet, governance, Identity, verification, or protocol authority.
Tracked evidence and reports contain no raw signing or bearer secrets.
Signing remains delegated to a qualified wallet/runtime boundary.
Off-chain service credentials confer no on-chain authority.
Required automated qualification suites have passing evidence.
Dependency/release evidence is reviewed for the candidate.
Production public service endpoints use HTTPS/WSS policy.
